lines.text: A ruler said he had kept the commandments from his youth, and Jesus told him to sell everything.
Jesus said a sheep passing through a needle's eye is easier than a rich man entering God's kingdom.
Jesus said those who leave home or family for God's kingdom will receive eternal life in the age to come, not before.

wrong_details.wrong: receive nothing in this age, only eternal life in the age to come
wrong_details.true: receive many times more in this age, and eternal life in the age to come
